items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: Rain was playing at that time, playing bass. And I was playing the guitar. ... That was the band then.

ctx.x: I'm trying to think who was playing bass with us then.

I can't think of the bass player. Rain was playing at that time, playing bass. And I was playing the guitar. Kimball was playing the bass. That's right. Young Kimball. That was the band then. And we stayed with that band about three or four years with Sidney's. And left them. Then I went and got Kimball, Louis Barbaran, Alvin Alcorn, and myself with the full tunes.
